died.name: Walter Milne
died.desc: last Protestant martyr burned in Scotland before the Scottish Reformation
died.last_words: Lord, have mercy upon me! Pray, people, while there is time.

died.name: Charles Bell
died.desc: Scottish physician, artist and philosophical theologian

died.name: Sir Andrew Agnew, 7th Baronet
died.last_words: Did the doctors really say I was not to get up?-If they said so, then I won't get up; but I feel well.-No, I will keep them [the pillows] as the doctors left them.

died.name: Clarabelle Lansing
died.cause: On Aloha Airlines Flight 243 from Hilo to Honolulu, Hawaii, the 58-year-old flight attendant was blown out of the Boeing 737-209 30000 ft above the Pacific Ocean when the plane experienced explosive decompression due to metal fatigue.

died.name: Anthony Nightingale
died.desc: victim of the Port Arthur massacre
died.cause: reacting to Martin Bryant pointing his weapon at him

born.name: Otho
born.cause: to a freedman, prior to committing suicide
born.last_words: Go and show yourself to the soldiers, lest they cut you to pieces for being accessory to my death.

born.name: Yi Sun-sin
born.cause: telling his nephew to hide his death by gunshot from his soldiers to avoid demoralizing them during the Battle of Noryang

born.name: James Monroe
born.cause: referring to his close friend James Madison
born.last_words: I regret that I should leave this world without again beholding him.

born.name: Thomas Crisp
born.desc: VC, DSC, Royal Naval Reserve, skipper of armed trawler Nelson
born.cause: to his son after being mortally wounded in a German submarine attack during World War I
born.last_words: Tom, I'm done. Throw me overboard.

born.name: Kurt Gödel
born.cause: The 71-year-old logician and mathematician developed an obsessive fear of being poisoned and refused to eat food prepared by anyone but his wife. When she became ill and was hospitalized, he starved to death. At the time of his death, he only weighed around 65 lb.
